<template>
  <AdvancedFilter
    v-model:displayFilter="downtimeTableStore.displayFilter"
    :storeRef="searchFiltersStore"

    @close-filter="onCloseFilter"
    @on-submit="onSubmit"
    @reset-filter="resetFilter"

<script setup lang="ts">
import { AdvancedFilter, removeLeadingZeros } from '@mesx/common-ui-lib';
import type { FilterField } from '@mesx/common-ui-lib';
import { computed, onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, inject, ref, watch } from 'vue';
import { useI18n } from 'vue-i18n';
import { Notify } from '../../../types/notify';
import * as api from '../service/api';
import useDowntimeTableStore from '../store/downtime-table-store';
import useFiltersStore from '../store/search-filter-store';
import { useProfileStore } from '../store/user-auth-store';
import { DownTimeCause } from '@/types/downtime-cause.dto';

// Access the store
const downtimeTableStore = useDowntimeTableStore();
const searchFiltersStore = useFiltersStore();
const profileStore = useProfileStore();
const { locale, t } = useI18n();

const ticketToClassifyOptions = computed<Array<string>>(() => [
  t('YES'),
  t('NO'),
]);

const getTicketToClassifyCode = (value: string): string | undefined => {
  if (value === t('YES')) {
    return '1';
  }

  if (value === t('NO')) {
    return '0';
  }

  return undefined;
};

const getTicketToClassifyCodes = (values: Array<string>): Array<string> => {
  const codes: Array<string> = [];

  for (const value of values) {
    const code = getTicketToClassifyCode(value);

    if (code && !codes.includes(code)) {
      codes.push(code);
    }
  }

  return codes;
};

const getTicketToClassifyLabel = (value: string): string | undefined => {
  if (value === '1') {
    return t('YES');
  }

  if (value === '0') {
    return t('NO');
  }

  return undefined;
};

const getTicketToClassifyLabels = (values: Array<string>): Array<string> => {
  const labels: Array<string> = [];

  for (const value of values) {
    const label = getTicketToClassifyLabel(value);

    if (label && !labels.includes(label)) {
      labels.push(label);
    }
  }

  return labels;
};

const notify = inject<Notify>('notify');
if (!notify) {
  throw new Error('Notify plugin is not properly injected.');
}

const normalizeCauseValues = (values: Array<unknown>): Array<string> => {
  const selectedCauseValues: Array<string> = [];

  for (const value of values) {
    const sourceValue =
      typeof value === 'object' && value !== null
        ? (value as Record<string, unknown>).cause
        : value;
    const parsed = Number.parseInt(String(sourceValue), 10);

    if (!Number.isNaN(parsed)) {
      const normalized = String(parsed);

      if (!selectedCauseValues.includes(normalized)) {
        selectedCauseValues.push(normalized);
      }
    }
  }

  return selectedCauseValues;
};

const causeDescriptionList = ref<Array<DownTimeCause>>([]);
onMounted(async () => {
  await searchFiltersStore.filterByCriteria();
  causeDescriptionList.value = await api.getAllCauseDesc();
  searchFiltersStore.cause = normalizeCauseValues(searchFiltersStore.cause);
  downtimeTableStore.updateColumnLabels();
  searchFiltersStore.ticketToClassifyLabel = getTicketToClassifyLabels(
    searchFiltersStore.ticketToClassify,
  );
});

onBeforeUnmount(() => {});

watch(
  () => searchFiltersStore.ticketToClassify,
  (newValue) => {
    searchFiltersStore.ticketToClassifyLabel =
      getTicketToClassifyLabels(newValue);
  },
);

watch(locale, () => {
  downtimeTableStore.updateColumnLabels();
  searchFiltersStore.ticketToClassifyLabel = getTicketToClassifyLabels(
    searchFiltersStore.ticketToClassify,
  );
});

// Define filter configuration
const filterConfig = computed<Array<FilterField>>(() => [
  {
    handler: (value: unknown): void => {
      const causeValues = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
      searchFiltersStore.cause = normalizeCauseValues(causeValues);
    },
    type: 'dropdown',
    modelKey: 'cause',
    label: 'CAUSE_DESCRIPTION',
    options: causeDescriptionList.value,
    optionLabel: 'cause_desc',
    optionValue: 'cause',
    multiSelect: true,
    useChips: true,
  },
  {
    type: 'dropdown',
    modelKey: 'tool',
    label: profileStore.managedBy === 'PART' ? 'PART' : 'TOOL',
    options: searchFiltersStore.tools,
    multiSelect: true,
    useChips: true,
    optionFormatter: removeLeadingZeros,
  },
  {
    type: 'dropdown',
    modelKey: 'shiftCode',
    label: 'SHIFT',
    options: ['1', '2', '3'],
    multiSelect: true,
    useChips: true,
  },
  {
    type: 'dropdown',
    modelKey: 'status',
    label: 'DOWNTIME_TICKET_STATUS',
    options: [
      { label: t('STATUS_ACTIVE'), value: 'Active' },
      { label: t('STATUS_CLOSED'), value: 'Closed' },
      { label: t('STATUS_DELETED'), value: 'Deleted' },
    ],
    optionLabel: 'label',
    optionValue: 'value',
    multiSelect: true,
    useChips: true,
  },
  {
    type: 'date',
    modelKey: 'startDate',
    label: 'START_DATE',
  },
  {
    type: 'date',
    modelKey: 'endDate',
    label: 'END_DATE',
  },
  {
    condition: (): boolean => profileStore.resourceType === 'JIT',
    filterable: false,
    handler: (value: unknown): void => {
      const ticketToClassifyValues = Array.isArray(value)
        ? value.map(String)
        : [];

      searchFiltersStore.ticketToClassify = getTicketToClassifyCodes(
        ticketToClassifyValues,
      );
      searchFiltersStore.ticketToClassifyLabel = ticketToClassifyValues;
    },
    label: 'TICKET_TO_CLASSIFY',
    modelKey: 'ticketToClassifyLabel',
    multiSelect: true,
    options: ticketToClassifyOptions.value,
    type: 'dropdown',
  },
]);

const onSubmit = async (event_: Event | SubmitEvent): Promise<void> => {
  const event = event_ as SubmitEvent;
  const submitter = event.submitter as HTMLButtonElement;
  const action = submitter.value;

  if (action === 'search') {
    try {
      await downtimeTableStore.fetchDowntimeOrderData();
      downtimeTableStore.displayFilter = false;
    } catch {
      // Handle error if needed
    }
  } else if (action === 'save') {
    try {
      await downtimeTableStore.fetchDowntimeOrderData();
      await searchFiltersStore.saveFilterPreferences();
    } catch {
      // Handle error if needed
    }
  }
};
const onCloseFilter = (): void => {
  downtimeTableStore.displayFilter = false;
};

const resetFilter = (): void => {
  searchFiltersStore.resetFilter();
};
</script>

/**
 * Convert a language code to an ISO country code used for flag icons.
 * @param code language code (e.g. 'en', 'en_US')
 * @returns lowercase country code suitable for flag CSS classes (e.g. 'us'), or
 * an empty string when no mapping is available
 */
export function langCodeToCountry(code: string): string {
  if (!code) return '';
  const normalized = String(code).replace('_', '-').toUpperCase();
  const mapEntries: Array<[string, string]> = [
    ['AF', 'za'],
    ['AR', 'sa'],
    ['BN', 'bd'],
    ['CS', 'cz'],
    ['DA', 'dk'],
    ['DE', 'de'],
    ['EN', 'us'],
    ['ES', 'es'],
    ['FA', 'ir'],
    ['FI', 'fi'],
    ['FR', 'fr'],
    ['HI', 'in'],
    ['HU', 'hu'],
    ['ID', 'id'],
    ['IT', 'it'],
    ['JA', 'jp'],
    ['KO', 'kr'],
    ['MS', 'my'],
    ['NL', 'nl'],
    ['NO', 'no'],
    ['PL', 'pl'],
    ['PT', 'pt'],
    ['RO', 'ro'],
    ['RU', 'ru'],
    ['SV', 'se'],
    ['SW', 'ke'],
    ['TH', 'th'],
    ['TR', 'tr'],
    ['VI', 'vn'],
    ['ZH', 'cn'],
  ];
  const map: Record<string, string> = Object.fromEntries(mapEntries);
  if (map[normalized]) return map[normalized];
  const prefix = normalized.split('-')[0];
  return map[prefix] ?? '';
}

/**
 * Build the flag CSS class for a language code.
 * @param code language code
 * @returns a flag CSS class like 'fi fi-us' or an empty string when not found
 */
export function getLanguageFlag(code: string): string {
  const cc = langCodeToCountry(code ?? '');
  return cc ? `fi fi-${cc}` : '';
}

/**
 * Resolve the human-readable language name from a language code.
 * @param code language code to resolve
 * @returns the language display name when found, otherwise returns the
 * original code value
 */
export function getLanguageName(code: string): string {
  const lang = languages.find(
    (l) =>
      l.code === code.toUpperCase() || l.code.startsWith(code.toUpperCase()),
  );
  return lang ? lang.name : code;
}
